title: Measurement and Modeling of Gas Solubility and Literature Review of the Properties for the Carbon Dioxide-Water System
experimental_method: Bubble point of known water-CO2 binaries at isothermal conditions in a variable-volume PVT cell (graphical technique, pressure versus volume).
uncertainties_stated: P +/-0.002 MPa, T +/-0.1 K (paper text); composition from analytical-balance loading (2 mg accuracy).

tables.table_4: 30 CSV rows = 27 data rows + 3 label rows

not_extracted_tables.Table 1: literature compilation of CO2 solubility data
not_extracted_tables.Table 2: literature compilation of water content data
not_extracted_tables.Table 3: literature compilation of hydrate dissociation data

quality_remarks: The capture split Table 4 into a header record and three body records (one per temperature range block) and the block labels exist only in wrapper_text; the CSV was assembled by script from those cells, left group then right group per block (right-group blank cells skipped).

The printed xCO2 values take only five values (0.00262, 0.0059, 0.01420, 0.02017, 0.02488) - they are the overall loading compositions, so each (T, P) pair is a bubble point of a given loading, not a free solubility isotherm.
Abstract range 274.14-351.31 K matches the table (274.14 to 351.31 K); Figure 3 caption says 273.15 to 353.15 K.
Rows between 304 and 322 K are labelled 'Tc < T' with Tc = 304.2 K in this table's block heading; row 303.99 K belongs to the previous block.
extraction_notes: Thin-space digit grouping inside xCO2 removed (0.002 62 -> 0.00262, 0.005 9 -> 0.0059, trailing zeros kept as printed: 0.014 20 -> 0.01420); this is a deviation from 'verbatim', recorded here. Label texts transliterated: '<=' for the less-or-equal sign.
mapping_audit: independent mapping audit 2026-10-02 (audit.json); cell-for-cell match with the captured HTML rows
